## At a glance

This release moves the portfolio to server-rendered content, loads optional features on demand, and makes the water navigation consistent across phones and desktops.

| Change | Why it matters |
| --- | --- |
| Server-rendered sections and native animations | Content arrives in the initial HTML; less JavaScript is needed to display the page. |
| Deferred QR, calendar and illustration effects | Optional features load when used or near the viewport. |
| Theme initialization and local font preloads | Shared theme links render consistently, with no navbar hydration mismatch. |
| Dependency cleanup and CI checks | Audits, content validation and bundle limits help catch regressions. |

[Explore the portfolio](https://katbose.dev) · [Read the architecture](https://docs.katbose.dev/architecture)

> Mobile and desktop now share the water shader. Reduced-motion preferences still use a static surface.
